n: Thames & Kosmos Robotics Workshop with micro:bit
t: A 248-piece kit for building 14 motorized robots coded with micro:bit and MakeCode.
steps: Find the kit from Thames & Kosmos or a retailer.
Check that the micro:bit is included in the version you buy.
Build one model from the manual.
Connect the micro:bit by USB or Bluetooth.
Open the MakeCode editor in a browser.
